Refactored the code to address issues CA1829 and CA1859 as per the suggestions of the analyzers in .NET 8. This PR resolves issue #14955.

## Changes Made
- [x] Refactored code to address CA1829.
- [x] Refactored code to address CA1859.

## Resolved / Related Issues
Closes #14955

## Validation
- [x] Built the app and tested the changes.
- [x] Checked for accessibility using Accessibility Insights.
- [x] Ensured no unused strings remained in the en-us resource file.
